key_insight: OPERAG combines retrieval with large language models to code free-text job descriptions without expert-labelled training databases, supporting large-scale occupational exposure assessment.
engineering_relevance: Retrieving classification-specific coding information offers a flexible alternative to supervised tools restricted to occupational classifications seen during training.
method: Retrieve relevant occupational coding index information.
Combine retrieved information with LLM-based occupational classification.
Link occupational codes to Job Exposure Matrices for exposure assessment.
evidence_signal: On 36,062 AsiaLymph job descriptions, OPERAG achieved 42.6% fourth-level coding accuracy and 89.9–98.6% exposure-assessment accuracy using ALOHA+ and SHOCK.
watch_item: Fourth-level coding accuracy remained below the reported 51–56% human inter-coder reliability, and validation on one cohort does not establish universal generalization.
paper_title: Automatic Occupational Coding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation
